If you want to add information about a new workshop for the UNSW CodeRs webpage, please fill this template with the following information:

## Metadata

Metadata will be entered in the front-matter of the entry in YAML format:
```
---
date: 
title: 
author:
---
```

## Abstract  

Please provide an abstract for the workshop in markdown format.

## Presenter information

Please provide presenter information, this can be in markdown format. Optionally, this can be added in the YAML as an author field.

## Image

Please add an image (foto or poster) for the workshop.

## Links

Do you have any links for the workshop? for example videos, GitHub repo, etc. Please add them in markdown format.
